abstract: Artificial intelligence is advancing at the same time as the global economy is becoming more fragmented. AI innovation is concentrated in a small number of economies, while the gains from AI depend on technologies, intermediate inputs, data, investment, and know-how moving across borders. This column shows that fragmentation can therefore shape not only the size of the global gains from AI, but also who receives them. For economies not at the technological frontier, preserving diversified links may be a valuable form of economic optionality.
abstract_zh: 人工智能的发展与全球经济日益碎片化同步推进。人工智能创新集中于少数经济体，而其收益则依赖于技术、中间投入、数据、投资和专业知识在跨国界的流动。本专栏指出，碎片化因此不仅影响人工智能全球收益的规模，也决定其分配格局。对于处于技术前沿之外的经济体而言，保持多元化的联系可能是一种宝贵的经济选择权。
authors: Barry Eichengreen, Jingyuan Cui, Asmaa El-Ganainy, Yevgeniya Korniyenko, Elyad Shojaei, Li Zeng, Shihangyin Zhang
title: AI in a fragmenting world: Why ‘connector’ economies can still gain
title_zh: 碎片化世界中的AI：为何“连接型”经济体仍能获益

abstract: Generative AT tools can help students complete assignments faster and achieve better scores. But completing these tasks is not the goal; learning from them is. This column uses data on over 25,000 7th to 12th grade students in China to examine how self-directed use of generative AI affects their learning. Time spent on homework for students who used AI went down and homework scores went up, but their exam scores fell. While the initial effect is small, it grows as students become more proficient with AI tools and as more course material is learned after adoption, suggesting that existing short-duration studies may underestimate the long-run learning costs of using generative AI.
abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能工具能帮助学生更快完成作业并取得更高分数。然而，完成这些任务并非目的，从中学习才是关键。本文基于中国超过25,000名7至12年级学生的数据，考察了自主使用生成式人工智能对其学习的影响。使用人工智能的学生在作业上花费的时间减少，作业成绩有所提升，但他们的考试成绩却出现下降。尽管初始影响较小，但随着学生对人工智能工具熟练度的提高以及采用后学习更多课程材料，这一影响逐渐增大，这表明现有短期研究可能低估了使用生成式人工智能的长期学习成本。
authors: David Strömberg, Victor Lei, Yanhui Wu
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: The generative AI learning penalty in secondary school
title_zh: 中学阶段生成式人工智能学习的不利影响

abstract: This article introduces an iterative distributed computing (IDC) estimator for the multinomial logistic regression model with large choice sets. The IDC estimator reformulates the estimation problem as a sequence of structured, low-dimensional subproblems that can be solved efficiently and in parallel. We establish that, when initialized with a consistent estimator, the IDC estimator is asymptotically equivalent to the maximum likelihood estimator and achieves asymptotic efficiency under a weak dominance condition. We further develop a parametric bootstrap procedure for inference based on the IDC estimator and prove its consistency. Extensive simulation studies validate the effectiveness of the proposed methods and highlight the computational efficiency of the IDC estimator.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种适用于大选择集多项逻辑回归模型的迭代分布式计算（IDC）估计量。IDC估计量将估计问题重构为一系列结构化、低维的子问题，这些子问题可高效并行求解。我们证明，在初始化为一致估计量的条件下，IDC估计量与最大似然估计量渐近等价，并在弱支配条件下实现渐近有效性。我们进一步开发了一种基于IDC估计量的参数自助法推断程序，并证明了其一致性。广泛的模拟研究验证了所提方法的有效性，并凸显了IDC估计量的计算效率。
title: Iterative distributed multinomial regression
title_zh: 迭代式分布式多项回归
